correctness.rationale: The slice aB∞+bB1 consists of the points with ∑(|x_i|−a)_+≤b; selecting the excess coordinates and integrating the resulting beta monomials gives the stated primal volume. The shifted polar's vertical fiber is [2−(1+t)||u||₁−(1−t)||u||∞]_+/(1−t²). In an ordered positive chamber the successive differences give simplex coefficients j+1+(j−1)t and unit Jacobian; the sign/order count and layer-cake integral give the stated polar volume. Strict convexity of polar volume and sign symmetry force the optimizing center to lie on the axis. The log denominator has negative second derivative, derivative at zero positive for d≥2, and derivative tending to −∞ at the top. The positive term gained going to d+1 moves its unique zero strictly up. With δ=1−τ and a_j=(j−1)/(2j), stationarity gives 1/δ=1/(2−δ)+∑a_j/(1−δ a_j). The lower bound (d−H_d)/2 on the sum gives δ=O(1/d), hence expansion gives 1/δ=d/2+O(log d). The log of the inverse correction product tends to one, and the remaining normalized factor tends to e/4. Checked d=1 directly (square, ratio one), and d=2 gives the stated radical and product. Inspected the frozen verification and checker without running them. The optional loop is over layer dimensions d=1–4, i.e. ambient dimensions 2–5, and the finite checks alone do not prove the asymptotic statements.
